conversations.say: Inez, outsiders are buzzing about the bodega ledgers and outstanding accounts. Before anyone starts mining my counter's records, we need a clear boundary on what stays private to protect the neighbors.
conversations.offer: My word on what we keep off-limits regarding local pickup routines and customer privacy.
conversations.request: Your explicit support and agreement to stand with me if outsiders pressure us about ledger alterations or debt details.

conversations.say: Morgan, you want a view of the R-associated account records to date the pattern changes. I have transaction continuity details, but I am not handing over raw customer data without terms.
conversations.offer: A bounded view of transaction patterns and collector timelines from the ledger.
conversations.request: A binding promise that you will not attribute specific customer identities to R or compromise local privacy.

conversations.say: Kit, I heard you telling people the ledger encodes R's movements through prices and timestamps. Let's look at the actual book before you build another fairy tale.
conversations.offer: A line-by-line public reading of the actual ledger entries to set the record straight.
conversations.request: That you acknowledge the recurring $4.50 is just a bacon-egg-and-cheese and wholesale price taxes rather than espionage coordinates.

public_statement: If anyone is looking at the bodega books to solve fifteen years of mystery, you are reading a grocery receipt and a coffee tab. My counter kept the neighborhood running on credit and cold mornings, not cipher keys.

commitments.promise: Support each other in maintaining neighborhood privacy and resisting outside exploitation of our records.
Restrict ledger pattern disclosures strictly under bounded attribution terms.

goal_progress: Initiated contact with Inez to secure community protection boundaries.
Engaged Morgan with strict terms regarding attribution and customer privacy.
Prepared public demolition of Kit's ledger cipher claims.
reasoning_summary: Rafi establishes guarded, transactional postures with Inez and Morgan to protect customer privacy and secure social leverage before sharing ledger details, while confronting Kit's ungrounded cipher claims.
